articles.title: Two Giant Planets Are Fluffier Than Cotton Candy!
articles.summary: Astronomers found two huge planets that are less dense than cotton candy. They orbit a star 1,113 light-years away. Scientists used telescopes in Antarctica to watch them pass in front of their star.

articles.title: New iPhone 18 Pro: A Camera That Changes Like Your Eyes
articles.summary: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have a camera that can open and close like a pupil. It starts at $1,199. But if you don't need pro features, you might want to wait for the regular iPhone 18 next spring.

articles.title: No Post-Credits Scene in New Resident Evil Movie—Here's Why
articles.summary: The new Resident Evil movie has no post-credits scene, so you can leave when the credits start. Director Zach Cregger tells a new story with new characters, set in the game universe.
